method_note: atom-level Shrake-Rupley (64 points), elements C/S/Se counted apolar and N/O polar; buried area = (free A + free B) - complex. No residue-composition approximation is used. dCp_per_1000A2 is the size-normalised comparison, because antibody interfaces are smaller and a raw dCp difference would partly restate that.
interpretation: A more negative dCp indicates greater apolar burial and a more hydrophobically (entropically) driven association. If antibody interfaces are enthalpy-leaning as Phase 2 inferred, their size-normalised dCp should be LESS negative than general PPI.
sign_correction: dCp uses the CHANGE in accessible area (negative on binding); an earlier version omitted the sign and reported positive dCp.
